body: @urvisism Thanks for reporting this issue. I tried to reproduce it [here](https://issues.streamlit.app/?issue=gh-9631), but for me its showing the correct time (tried it in firefox as well). Does the linked example also show 30:00 minutes in you browser?
Hi @urvisism by any chance, are you in a timezone that has a 30-minute offset from utc?

My hypothesis is that [this line](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/0184eced4c9108ba5efa8778ff0d7ddf1218b850/frontend/lib/src/components/widgets/AudioInput/formatTime.ts#L20) is causing some unintended side effects.
Going to close this issue due to inactivity.

> Hi @urvisism by any chance, are you in a timezone that has a 30-minute offset from utc?

No, I am in timezone UTC+05:30.

> My hypothesis is that [this line](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/0184eced4c9108ba5efa8778ff0d7ddf1218b850/frontend/lib/src/components/widgets/AudioInput/formatTime.ts#L20) is causing some unintended side effects.

Hi, @lukasmasuch @kmcgrady ,
Is there any possibility to check this point suggested by @sfc-gh-nbellante ?
I'm reopening the issue since it sounds like it appears for all timezone with x:30 offset. I think the time formatting needs to be fixed in audio input.
